item.title: No deal announced after Trump meeting to make 'final determination' on Iran
item.description: The US president met his advisers, after officials confirmed the US and Iran had agreed a framework of a deal.

item.title: US not 'turning back' on Asia allies, but expects them to boost defence, says Hegseth
item.description: The US defense secretary is questioned about US commitment, including further arms deals, at an Asian security summit in Singapore.

item.title: US, UK and Australia to develop underwater drone technology
item.description: The technology, developed under the Aukus military pact, is aimed at protecting undersea cables and boosting naval defence.

item.title: Four more men freed from flooded Laos cave after 10 days
item.description: Two of the seven villagers who entered the narrow tunnels in search for gold on 20 May are still missing.

item.title: Nato and EU condemn Russia after drone hits Romanian residential block
item.description: Romania says the Russian drone was likely hit over Ukraine by its air defences and altered its trajectory.

item.title: 'Poison seller' who sold toxic chemicals online to people across world admits aiding suicides
item.description: Kenneth Law admitted charges relating to Canadian victims - but families say he should also be charged in the UK over 79 deaths in Britain.

item.title: Ghana's parliament passes anti-LGBTQ+ bill
item.description: Same-sex acts are punishable by jail terms under Ghana's new bill targeting those identifying as gay, lesbian or transgender.

item.title: Spain's Sánchez digs in after eight years as PM as wave of scandals threatens survival
item.description: Corruption probes of colleagues and relatives have put Spain's premier into a fight for survival.

item.title: Israel put on UN sexual violence in warzones blacklist for first time
item.description: Israel says it rejects allegations in a new report by the office of the UN secretary general.

item.title: Exploding rocket casts doubts over Nasa's Moon plans
